ownership.owns: The high-level seaborn-style plotting API in scikitplot.seaborn: aucplot, evalplot, decileplot, modelplot, print_labels, their plotter classes, semantic mapping glue, focused tests, and compatibility behavior against supported seaborn/matplotlib/sklearn/pandas versions.
ownership.does_not_own: Upstream seaborn private APIs, matplotlib internals, sklearn metric semantics, the vendored scikitplot.externals._seaborn implementation, decile package APIs outside this submodule, or root scikitplot packaging.

auc.description: ROC/PR plotting with sklearn metrics and seaborn-like vector semantics.

boundary_contract.compatibility_rule: Do not rely directly on unstable seaborn private color-resolution behavior without a local compatibility seam tested against supported Matplotlib versions.
boundary_contract.model_rule: modelplot(kind=feature_importances) must actually derive the visualization from x_estimator model attributes; x_estimator cannot be decorative metadata.
boundary_contract.weight_rule: decileplot weights must affect decile aggregation or be rejected/removed; validated weights may not be silently discarded.
boundary_contract.semantic_mapping_rule: Public hue_order/hue_norm/palette arguments must be forwarded to hue mapping consistently with aucplot/evalplot/modelplot.
